content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Regulated electric and gas utility delivering to customers under tariffs; target mines thermal coal and sells it under contract."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Primarily a natural gas producer and gatherer in Texas; target is a coal miner and coal-fired power seller."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Regulated gas and electric distribution plus propane; no coal mining or coal-fired generation."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Mines salt and potash fertilizer for road, food and agriculture markets; no coal mining or power generation."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Regulated electric, gas and steam delivery utility in New York; target sells coal and generated power wholesale."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Corn-based fuel ethanol producer; different feedstock, process and end markets from coal mining and power."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Mines potash and langbeinite for fertilizer and deicing; shares mining but not coal or power generation."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Midstream gas gathering, processing and NGL transport in the Permian; no coal mining or power sales."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Nitrogen chemicals and HVAC heat pumps; no coal mining or coal-fired electricity business."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Regulated New Jersey gas utility with appliance service plans; different customers and model from coal supply."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Regulated natural gas distribution and propane delivery to homes; no coal mining or power generation."},{"label":"C12","good":false,"reason":"Regulated electric and gas utility serving retail customers in New Mexico and Texas; not a coal supplier."},{"label":"C13","good":false,"reason":"Ethylene production from ethane and propane for petrochemical buyers; unrelated to coal mining and power."}]}
